what.text: This page follows refugees from Lebanon in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 9568 refugees from Lebanon.
Germany hosts the largest share, 32.7%, followed by Canada, Denmark and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Lebanon from 1982 to 1986 and in 1989 and 1990, with groups including Amal and the Lebanese Forces.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Lebanon in 2014 to 2015 and 2017.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1982 at 12590 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 33140, at the end of 1985.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1983 to 1985 and 2002 to 2005.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country; people displaced inside Lebanon are counted separately.
